title: WebCrawler comparison
description: changes.json: what changed between two crawls (--compare, --diff, --monitor).

summary.description: one line, e.g. '1 regression(s), 2 new page(s), ...'

suppressed.description: new findings left out because they are accepted

section.description: the kind of change; risk-new, header-weaker, site-new, script-new, status-changed and dns-changed are regressions

subject.description: the page, link, host or '<n> places' it is about

code.description: the finding code, when the change is about a finding

count.description: how many findings a grouped line stands for
